supplementary.basis: Two string type guards, one ko-versus-other branch, and literal interpolation of two supplied strings into completely specified messages. There is no parser, localization lookup, escaping, fallback negotiation, mutable state or interacting transformation. Whitespace/empty preservation and unsupported-locale fallback are direct branches, not sufficient additional substance. The exact output tests are consistent, but cannot make this fixed-format wrapper nontrivial. Comparable to held Go generation0137/0416, not to the JavaScript sample's stateful callback or bounded-arithmetic targets. Template literals and validation are idiomatic; correctness is not the hold basis.

The full target combines synchronously thrown validation with a Promise-returning successful API, one asynchronous settlement per bounded task, stable input-index output order, and fresh arrays. A top-level async function would violate the synchronous-error boundary; collecting completion-order reports could violate ordering. Promise.all preserves input order while queueMicrotask implements the expressly required per-task asynchronous settlement. These interacting asynchronous/API constraints are substantive beyond the ready/held string formula. The final sort is redundant because Promise.all already preserves order, but is bounded at 1000, local and semantically harmless; this isolated unnecessary sort does not warrant an idiom hold. Constructing promises around queueMicrotask is not wrapping an already existing promise.

One ASCII prefix guard and concatenation select the only dynamic value; all five field definitions and all four booleans/type values are supplied verbatim. The complete solution instantiates fixed literals and freezes a known two-level structure. Freshness and Object.freeze calls are direct library operations, not a general recursive freezer, graph traversal, schema derivation or interacting state constraint. Closely matches frozen held TypeScript generation0260, a constant palette with frozen copied fields. The field helper is idiomatic; exact schema/order/freeze tests are valid but do not establish nontriviality.

Unrestricted nonempty string title words must capitalize their first character. Reference splits a supplementary cased character into UTF-16 halves before uppercasing, so it cannot capitalize that character. The prompt does not prescribe charAt or limit its input to BMP/ASCII.

The href expression explicitly requires encodeURIComponent(code). Its native lone-surrogate error behavior is not overridden by a promise to repair malformed UTF-16, suppress URIError or skip otherwise string-valued records. No custom total URI encoder is implied.
